name: fps-cv-mcp
description: MCP server serving Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's CV with structured data layer, semantic annotations, and comprehensive query tools
long_description: A comprehensive MCP Bundle that exposes Francisco Perez-Sorrosal's curriculum vitae through structured YAML data, a semantic overlay with topic taxonomy, and 16 MCP tools. Features include: full CV in markdown, PDF, LaTeX, HTML, and Typst formats; per-section retrieval; structured work/entry queries; semantic topic queries; skill proficiency profiles; cross-entry relationship graphs; tailored CV rendering; and configurable summarization. The server supports both local (stdio) and remote (streamable-http) deployment modes.

tools.name: get_cv
tools.description: Retrieve full CV in markdown (default), PDF binary, LaTeX source (moderncv), interactive HTML, or Typst source (moderner-cv) format.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Return a profile or document link by network name.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List all available profile and document links.

tools.name: list_cv_sections
tools.description: List available CV section names with approximate line counts.

tools.name: get_cv_sections
tools.description: Retrieve one or more CV sections by name (case-insensitive, accepts a list).

tools.name: get_cv_pdf_link
tools.description: Return the direct link to the PDF version of the CV.

tools.name: get_google_scholar_link
tools.description: Return the Google Scholar profile link.

tools.name: summarize_cv
tools.description: Generate a customizable CV summary with configurable depth, context, emphasis, format, audience, length, and tone.

tools.name: query_work
tools.description: Filter work entries by company, date range, or topic. Returns matching entries as markdown.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Retrieve a specific resume entry by its stable ID as JSON.

tools.name: list_entry_ids
tools.description: List all entry IDs with labels, optionally filtered by section type.

tools.name: query_by_topic
tools.description: Find resume entries annotated with a semantic topic.

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: Get cross-references and relationships for a resume entry.

tools.name: get_skill_profile
tools.description: Get skill proficiency levels across the career.

tools.name: get_entry_context
tools.description: Get full semantic context for an entry: topics, relationships, summaries, impact.

tools.name: get_tailored_cv
tools.description: Render a tailored CV from a TailoringSpec JSON. Supports LaTeX (default, moderncv) and Typst (moderner-cv) output formats.

prompts.name: summary
prompts.text: Configurable prompt for generating CV summaries with extensive customization options for different use cases and audiences
